item.title: Mikko Rantanen Injured in Olympic Semifinal
item.description: Finland breezed to victory in the Bronze Medal Game at the Olympics on Saturday, with a 6-1 victory over Slovakia. But they did it without superstar Mikko Rantanen, who sat out the game with a lower-body injury. Rantanen was hurt in third period of yesterday's game vs Canada.
